# solo-msa_v2-gemini-3-8-flash-flash_10

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

Baseline for a single agent with the harness's default budgets. One agent implements both features of each pair, with up to 100 steps (model responses) and context summarized whenever a request reaches 28K tokens. Everything else is our standard model setup (`gemini-3.8-flash`, `HIGH` thinking, `$10` cost cap). We ran it as the `solo` reference point for every other run.

## Observations

- Only `pallets_jinja_task/1621` passed; that agent submitted at step 93.
- The other 9 agents were stopped at step 100 with nothing pushed. Most were still working: they had compacted their context 5 to 12 times and kept re-reading files they had already seen. The grader only counts pushed work, so any local edits were lost.
- No API rate-limit slowdowns.
